data.name: Rebecca
data.gender_notes: Rebecca is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Rivqah, from the root r-b-q, 'to bind, tie'. Its root is Hebrew r-b-q. Rebecca, wife of Isaac (Genesis 24). Rebecca is a Hebrew name meaning “To bind; to tie firmly”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rebecca expresses “To bind; to tie firmly”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Rivqah, from the root r-b-q, 'to bind, tie'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rebecca total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
